Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this game! England have come back from behind and won their first game of a three-match series after a long time. They have also received 40 points in the ICC World Test Championship. Pakistan, on the other hand, will need to recover from this loss quickly and perform better in crunch situations. The next Test begins on 13th August, 2020 at 1100 Local (1000 GMT) in Southampton. Until then, cheers and take care.

Chris Woakes, the MAN OF THE MATCH, says playing positive was the way to go especially after Pope fell and he talked to Buttler about it. Adds that the idea to take it to Pakistan worked and seeing Jos Buttler bat like that was good. Says that it was a great partnership and Jos is one of the best white-ball players in the world and he showed that he can play well in Tests too. Goes onto say that he has been working hard in the nets and tried to get into form. States that he focussed on the ball and luckily, it worked. Is pleased to take the wickets of the big chaps in the Pakistan team as they can do a lot of damage.

Joe Root, the England skipper, says that it was a fantastic Test match and brilliant cricket was played for all the four days. Adds that Woakes and Buttler were pretty clever with how they played. States that it took something special but they believed that anything can happen and they never gave up. Says that Buttler did really well and he managed the risks well and how he played the spinners was fantastic to see. Adds that they need to back up their performance but realizes that they need to improve on certain aspects of the game.

Azhar Ali, the Pakistan skipper, says that it was a wonderful Test but is disappointed to be on the wrong end of it. Credits Woakes and Buttler for playing really  well and they changed the momentum of the game. Adds that when someone plays like that, it is difficult to set fields. States that this innings from Woakes and Buttler was not far from how Stokes played against Australia last year. Goes on to say that they would have enjoyed more with the crowds. Says that it was a surprise that the ball did not reverse later on. States that they had the opportunity to bat England out of the game but suddenly they lost wickets and it is unfortunate not to get more runs on the board. Ends by saying that they should have defended this total.
Stay tuned for the Presentation ceremony as we find out who the Man of the Match is.

277 though still seemed a little out of reach for England on this wicket. The feeling was proving to be correct when they were five down for 117. One partnership though, one brilliant stand, two excellent individually brilliant knocks has taken them over the line. The visitors' bowlers were excellent till the Buttler-Woakes stand. The younger ones, the ones who lacked experience, probably crumbled under pressure and had no answers to the counterattack from the two. Yasir Shah, the experienced campaigner, once again impressed with a four-fer but he lacked support when needed. In the end, this could well be termed as a demoralizing loss.

For Pakistan, this is going to be a difficult loss to take. They would have felt in control of this Test right from the first day when Masood�s marathon innings took them to a competitive total. Then, Yasir�s four-fer saw them bundle out England for 107 runs less than what they scored in their first innings. England did fight back with the ball as a combined effort saw them bowl Pakistan out for 169.

What a turnaround we have witnessed! If any of you�ll thought that England would win when they lost their 5th wicket, you should probably go buy yourself a lottery ticket because we never felt so. It was a tremendous effort from Buttler and Woakes. Take a bow the two of you. A 139-run stand between the two and that too in quick time has single-handledly taken the hosts over the line. This session was all about the two. Yes, Buttler was dismissed towards the end but Woakes with the lower order ensured that the hosts get over the line.

Pakistan's session easily but the partnership between Buttler and Woakes just gives a sense of the momentum shifting in favour of England. Pakistan is still on top but this stand might just be getting them worried. However, they were excellent right from the word go after Lunch. They got wickets once again at regular intervals and have got rid of the top and the middle order of the England side. They would know another two wickets or so and they would be into the tail. However, Buttler and Woakes are looking pretty comfortable out there especially the latter who has come out with a lot more intent. They need to go on for longer. Another 110 runs are needed and they would want this pair to score as much as possible. Can they do so, can they continue the fightback? We will find out after the break.

OUT! There is a spike on Ultra Edge and Stokes is a goner! He walks off with a shocked look on his face but judging by the replays, it did seem like it kissed the glove. Pakistan are ecstatic as they have got Stokes once again for a low score. Huge wicket as Stokes is a match-winner, the visitors are clear favourites now. Stokes was always going to have a tough time against Yasir with all the rough outside the off stump and he falls to one which lands in it. It takes off and also zips through. Stokes looks to move out of the way but it seems to have taken his glove and Rizwan initially does not take it as it pops out but he hangs on in the second attempt.
A review taken for caught behind now! It seems that Stokes has missed it. The Ultra Edge shows that there is a spike as it passes the gloves. Excellent review.

That has turned a long way! It lands outside off, it turns back in a long way. Hits Stokes on the pad as he tries to flick. This is going to be a real test for Stokes with the ball turning out off the rough. A huge appeal but the umpire does not agree. Pakistan review after a discussion. Replays show that the on-field call has to be overturned.
Close! Pope comes down the track and does not get to the pitch of the ball. He looks to drive but the ball spins away a touch. It goes off the outer half towards cover for one.
The slider on middle, Pope goes back and defends it onto the ground.
Shorter and outside off, Pope looks to cut but mistimes it towards point.
That turns and stays low! Slow spin though! It lands on middle and turns away, it also stays low. Pope does well to get his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Short ball around middle, Stokes looks to pull but misses.

NOT OUT! Poor, poor review! It looked like it will go down the leg side from the naked eye. Good length ball on the pads, Stokes comes ahead and looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Pakistan put up an appeal but nothing from the umpire. Azhar Ali reviews. The Ultra Edge shows nothing while the Ball Tracker shows that it is missing the leg stump. Wonder what made the Pakistan skipper go for the review. A review wasted.
Review time! Pakistan have taken a review for LBW! The Ultra Edge shows no bat. Poor review as Ball Tracker shows it is missing the leg stump.
Good length ball on middle, Stokes lunges forward and blocks it to the leg side.
Fuller one on middle, Ben whips it but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Very full delivery on off, Stokes digs it out towards point.
Good length ball on middle, Stokes blocks it to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, Pope cuts but straight to the point fielder.
Flighted on off, Pope blocks it to point.
Tossed up on middle, Ben flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Stokes looks to attack the spinner now! Flighted on middle, Stokes reverse sweeps it through point for a boundary.

An appeal for LBW turned down! It has gone off the bat anyway! Loopy ball on off, Stokes looks to flick but it takes the outside edge and rolls to the point region. Yasir appeals but nothing from the umpire.
Flatter one on middle, Stokes blocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Strays on the pads and it has been punished! 100 up for England! Good length ball on the pads, Pope flicks it to the deep square leg region for a boundary. Pope is also off the mark.
Full ball on off, Pope drives it to mid off for nothing.
Ollie Pope makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! The England skipper is out of here! Big wicket for Pakistan! They will believe that they can win this from here! Brilliant stuff from Naseem Shah. Pakistan are on top now. Good length ball outside off, moving away. Root looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes to first slip at a catchable height. Azam will not drop those and Root has to walk back. He got off to a start but like many times in his career, he has thrown it away. England still a long way away from achieving a victory.
Good length ball on middle, Root defends it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, Root strides forward and blocks it to cover.
Full ball on middle, Root pushes it to mid on.
Tossed up on middle, Stokes lunges and defends it out.
Floated on middle, Ben works it to short leg.
Flatter one on the pads, Stokes pads it away.
Short delivery outside off, Root punches it to deep cover for a single.
On the pads, Root pads it away.
FOUR! Lovely controlled shot from Root! Floated on middle, Root reverse sweeps it towards the third man region for a boundary. Moves into the 40s.
Good length ball on middle, Stokes defends it back to the bowler.
Outside off, left alone.

EDGY FOUR! Stokes is off the mark in a tricky fashion! Good length ball on off, Stokes looks to leave it at first but then decides to defend. It goes off the outside edge and through the slip cordon for another boundary.
Fullish ball on off, Stokes taps it to point.
Back of a length ball on off, Stokes blocks it to mid off.
Good length ball on middle, Root flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Ben Stokes is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sibley cannot resist the drive and it has cost him! Big wicket for Pakistan and the door has been opened for them. Yasir bowls a floated ball outside off, Sibley's eyes lit up and looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and goes to first slip where Asad Shafiq takes a simple catch. England still need 191 more runs to win.
Low full toss on middle, Root sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Full on middle, Root defends it out onto the pitch.
The batsman offers no stroke and is wrapped on the pads.
That bounced a little extra! Shah tosses this one on middle, turns away and bounces. Root does well to leave it alone.
FOUR! Excellently cut away by Root! Flatter delivery outside off, Root cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Full delivery on middle, Sibley nudges it to mid-wicket.
Full delivery on the middle stump line, Root tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length on off, Root blocks it to the cover region.
FOUR! Nicely played from Root! He is looking good! Back of a length ball outside off, Root guides it through the gully region for a boundary. England need below 200 now.
TWO LEG BYES! Full ball on the pads, Root looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball goes to deep square leg and the batters pick up a couple of leg byes.
Good length ball on off, Root prods forward and pushes it to cover.
A couple to end! On middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for two.
On middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
Floats it up but lands it outside leg. Padded away.
One more ball outside off, not played at.
This one pitches outside leg and hence, Sibley does not offer a shot.
This lands on off and then turns away. Left alone.
A solid defense to end! On off, kept out.
Edged but well short! Played that with soft hands did Root! Length and on off, Root looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge well short of the first slip fielder.
Outside off, Root shoulders arms to this one.
Angled into the off pole, Root blocks it nicely.
Good shot for no runs! Slightly shorter and just outside off, Root stays leg side of the ball and guides it to gully.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
Naseem Shah is back on. 5-2-10-0 are his figures so far.

Full ball on middle, Sibley flicks it to deep square leg and picks up a couple. 50-run partnership comes up between the two. An important one for England. They would know that their job is only half done and they need to continue.
The batsman offers no stroke and gets hit on the pad.

Root now takes a few steps ahead and defends this ball on off.

Angled into the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
On middle, defended.

Yasir goes around the wicket. He lands it outside leg. Sibley pads it away.

On middle, kept out.

The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Angled into the pads, Root misses the flick and wears it onto the pads.

Leading edge but safe! Luck not going Pakistan's way at the moment. There are two gullies in place but it evades both. It is on middle, it straightens a touch. Root looks to work it on the leg side which is against the movement. It goes off the leading edge but short of point.
Fuller and on off, Sibley drives it towards covers.

Tossed up outside off, Sibley watches it go to the keeper.

Shorter and outside off, Root goes back and cuts but to point. Batting seems to have gotten a touch easier at the moment.

Full delivery on middle, Root flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on off, Root defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Short and outside off, Root cuts it behind point for a boundary.
PLAY AND A MISS! Flatter one outside off, Sibley looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.

NOT OUT! Excellent review from Sibley! It looked like Sibley had missed to the naked eye. Tossed up ball outside off, spinning a mile. Sibley goes on his front foot to defend but seems to have missed. Pakistan think otherwise as they put in a huge appeal. The umpire agrees and raises the finger. Sibley reviews immediately. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows no spike. Perfect use of the review from Dom Sibley.
Dom Sibley has been given out caught behind! Sibley has reviewed it immediately. There is daylight between bat and pad.
Quicker on middle, defended back to the bowler.

Careful, Sibley! Flatter one outside off. Sibley leaves it alone. That goes just past the off stump.
Yasir Shah will bowl from the other end.
Good length ball outside off, Root leaves it alone.

FOUR! Brilliant from Root! He needs to keep playing these kind of shots! Fullish on off, Root moves ahead and across, to take the LBW out of the equation. He flicks it towards the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Full delivery on middle, Root plays it back to the bowler.

BEATEN! What a lovely delivery from Abbas! Good length ball outside off, straightening after pitching. Root looks to defend but he seems to have missed it. Rizwan is confident that Root has edged it but the bowler is not. They do not take the review.
Full ball on middle, Root pushes it to mid on.
Abbas starts with a good length ball on off, Root defends it to the cover region.

All set for the second session of Day 4! The Pakistan players make their way out to the middle, followed by Joe Root and Dom Sibley. They need 222 runs more to win. Mohammad Abbas will start with the ball for the visiting side.
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

So, England have started their chase quite nicely! Yes, they have lost Burns but Root and Sibley have then looked to steady things and are now looking comfortable out there. However, there is still a long way to go and it will be vital for the hosts for the two to make use of the starts they have got. Pakistan, on the other hand, have bowled decently. They have hit the right lines and lengths on most of the occasions but the key here is to be patient and one feels, they would get the rewards. However, the first sessions in this Test have mostly been good for the English. It is the second session where they falter. They can't afford that now so it will be interesting to see how they go about things. Join us at 1340 Local (1240 GMT) for the second session.
Floated on middle, Root works it to square leg for a single. LUNCH ON DAY 4.

EDGED BUT SHORT! Just short actually! This is a length delivery outside off, it skids through. Sibley looks to block but does so inside the line. It goes off the outside edge but lands just short of first slip. The slip fielders are probably standing a yard behind for Shah. He is more of a skiddy bowler so you would want to be a couple of steps ahead than you usually are for another bowler.

WOW! What a delivery! Pace, carry, movement, it had everything but does not produce a wicket. It is angled into the off pole again from wide of the crease. It pitches, straightens and also takes off. Beats the outside edge of Sibley's bat as he tries to defend.
Fuller and on middle, it is pushed to mid on.
Does the right thing this time, Yasir invites Root to cut again by bowling a slider outside off. Root resists and lets it be.
BEATEN! Almost a replay of how Root got out in the first innings! Poor shot. This is a little too close to cut. Shortish and outside off, it skids through. Root goes back and looks to cut but misses.

Gives it nice amonut of flight. It is a fraction fuller than it needs to be. Easily blocked.

A full toss on the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Yasir Shah comes onto bowl! He picked up a 4-fer in the first innings. Can he have the same impact in the second as well?
Shorter and on off, Root goes back and keeps it out. So just the boundary from the over. Overall a good one by Shah.
FOUR! Easy-peasy! Slips one onto the pads, Root is way too strong there, he works it through square leg and bags a boundary.

OUT! LBW! Coming around the wicket does the trick for Abbas! Abbas was confident in his appeal! Brilliant piece of bowling from Abbas! He has delivered for Pakistan yet again. Burns has a discussion with Sibley and goes for the review. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows no bat. What about Ball Tracker? It shows that it is umpire's call. Review retained. Burns walks off but not before engaging in some words with the Pakistan players. England still need 255 runs.
Rory Burns has been given out LBW! He has taken the review! The Ultra Edge shows no bat. The Ball Tracker shows that it is umpire's call.
